name: morse-e2e
label: Morse / CW canary
description: First-principles canary for the Morse decode chain — no SDR required. `MorseAudioSource` synthesises a 22050 Hz mono CW tone of the configured `text` at the configured `wpm` (default `PARIS PARIS PARIS` at 18 wpm, the WPM-calibration word) and feeds it directly to `MorseDemod`. Decoded characters stream into the Logs tab under `decoder::cw` — should match the input text after a few seconds of bit-timing lock. Useful for verifying the multimon-ng wrapper end-to-end without depending on band conditions.
